motivation: Replace exhaustive target behavior enumeration with the weakest target information actually required for sound terminal proof.

definitions.V_E: SET_OF_OPUS55 DEPLOYED POLICY KERNELS CONSISTENT WITH E
definitions.O_STAR: THE ACTUAL FROZEN OPUS55 TARGET KERNEL, ASSUMED TO LIE IN V_E
definitions.B: THE ACTUAL DEPLOYED BRAIN OWNED KERNEL
definitions.TERMINAL_EQUIVALENCE: O0 ~ O1 IFF NO LOAD_BEARING TERMINAL EVALUATOR, HARD CONSTRAINT, OR CONTEXT USED BY THE FROZEN TARGET DISTINGUISHES THEIR RELEVANT COMPARATOR CONSEQUENCES
definitions.DOMINATES: B WEAKLY DOMINATES A TARGET EQUIVALENCE CLASS UNDER THE COMPLETE TERMINAL ORDER FOR EVERY ADMISSIBLE CONTEXT
definitions.BAD_SET: {q IN Q_E : B DOES NOT DOMINATE q ON AT LEAST ONE ADMISSIBLE TERMINAL CONTEXT}

theorem: ROBUST_SUFFICIENCY: IF O_STAR IS REPRESENTED IN Q_E AND BAD_SET IS EMPTY AND L2 OWNERSHIP GATES PASS, THEN THE TERMINAL DOMINANCE CLAIM HOLDS WITHOUT IDENTIFYING O_STAR EXACTLY.
INFORMATION_INSUFFICIENCY: IF Q_E CONTAINS q0 AND q1 THAT ARE INDISTINGUISHABLE UNDER CURRENT E BUT B DOMINATES q0 AND DOES NOT DOMINATE q1, THEN E ALONE DOES NOT ENTAIL THE TERMINAL CLAIM.
MINIMUM_TARGET_INFORMATION: NEW TARGET INFORMATION IS REQUIRED ONLY TO EXCLUDE BAD_SET OR REFINE Q_E TO A SUBSET WITH EMPTY BAD_SET; RECONSTRUCTING THE FULL TARGET POLICY IS NOT NECESSARY.
TERMINAL_QUOTIENT_RULE: TARGET DIFFERENCES THAT CANNOT CHANGE ANY LOAD_BEARING TERMINAL ORDER OR HARD CONSTRAINT MUST BE MERGED BEFORE INFORMATION ACQUISITION.

AGGREGATE_BAR_RULE: WHEN THE FROZEN TERMINAL ATOM IS ONLY AN AGGREGATE PUBLIC THRESHOLD, CASE_LEVEL TARGET OUTCOMES ARE NOT REQUIRED UNLESS THEY ARE NEEDED TO ESTABLISH THE AGGREGATE OR A STRONGER SCOPE CERTIFICATE.
ABSOLUTE_CEILING_BYPASS: ANY TARGET_INDEPENDENT CERTIFICATE SHOWING B IS TERMINALLY OPTIMAL ON A CONTEXT REMOVES THAT CONTEXT FROM BAD_SET ANALYSIS WITHOUT OPUS OUTPUT.
VERSION_SPACE_REFINEMENT: ANY SOUND FIRST_PARTY FACT, EXACT COMPARATOR RESULT, IMPLEMENTATION CHARACTERIZATION, OR OTHER TARGET EVIDENCE MAY BE USED ONLY BY ITS PROVED EFFECT ON Q_E.

finite_countermodel.consequence: CURRENT_EVIDENCE_CANNOT_DETERMINE TERMINAL TRUTH UNTIL q1 IS EXCLUDED OR B IS IMPROVED TO DOMINATE q1.

anti_overquery_counterexample.setting: A FROZEN ACCEPTANCE ATOM DEPENDS ONLY ON AN AGGREGATE SCORE S.
anti_overquery_counterexample.target_policies: O0 AND O1 DIFFER ON ONE INDIVIDUAL CASE BUT HAVE THE SAME LOAD_BEARING AGGREGATE S AND IDENTICAL HARD_CONSTRAINT CONSEQUENCES.
anti_overquery_counterexample.result: O0 AND O1 ARE TERMINALLY EQUIVALENT FOR THAT ATOM; QUERYING WHICH ONE PASSED THE INDIVIDUAL CASE HAS ZERO TERMINAL INFORMATION VALUE.

scheduler_consequence: STOP TREATING EXHAUSTIVE TARGET ENUMERATION AS THE DEFAULT INFORMATION OBJECT.
CONSTRUCT THE SOUND TARGET VERSION SPACE IMPLIED BY CURRENT EVIDENCE, THEN QUOTIENT OUT TERMINALLY IRRELEVANT TARGET DIFFERENCES.
SUBTRACT CONTEXTS CLOSED BY ABSOLUTE OR FORMAL BRAIN CEILING PROOFS.
SEARCH FOR A CONSTRUCTIVE BAD_SET EQUIVALENCE CLASS CONSISTENT WITH CURRENT EVIDENCE.
IF BAD_SET SURVIVES, CHOOSE THE CHEAPEST MOVE BETWEEN IMPROVING B TO DOMINATE THAT REGION AND ACQUIRING THE MINIMUM TARGET FACT THAT EXCLUDES IT.
NEVER QUERY CASE_LEVEL TARGET BEHAVIOR WHEN ONLY AN AGGREGATE TERMINAL PREDICATE IS LOAD_BEARING AND THE CASE RESULT CANNOT CHANGE THAT PREDICATE.
IF BAD_SET IS EMPTY UNDER A SOUND COMPLETE QUOTIENT CONSTRUCTION, TARGET_SPECIFIC INFORMATION ACQUISITION IS DONE.
